The '''Port City of Guixu''' was a former settlement located on the western coast of Outer [[Huanglong]]. Hundreds of years ago, it hosted the world's tallest building. The Incinero Petal Toxin from the Sea of Flames caused the destruction and mass evacuation of the city. Before the Lament descended upon the city, leaving nothing but ruin, Guixu had an outdoor music venue at Nostalgia Isle, as well as a record shop within the city. Its remains now float in the air with a menacing black hole behind it, reminding all of Jinzhou what came before.
